Ather scooters in Chennai

Our main showroom and the flagship Ather experience centre on OMR. Full line-up on the floor, test rides from the door, service bays and a finance desk in the same building.

What you can do here

  • Sit on and ride every model we stock, free, no appointment strictly needed
  • Get a written on-road quote with RTO and insurance broken out
  • Apply for finance at the desk — most approvals come back the same day
  • Periodic service, warranty work and genuine Ather parts
  • Buy accessories and the Halo smart helmet off the shelf

Areas we serve from here

Kottivakkam, Thiruvanmiyur, Perungudi, Sholinganallur, Velachery, Adyar, Navalur and the whole IT corridor.

Home test rides can be arranged within this area — ask when you enquire.
